description: Fallback / credit-consuming visual generator: prefer generating visuals yourself in chat (and injecting via base64Images, svgImages/svgMarkup, openaiFileIdRefs, imageUrls, or wordflux_upload_media) or reusing wordflux_list_media first. Use this tool only when you cannot generate images yourself or when the user explicitly requests WordFlux stock photos or Brand Template overlays (logo, brand colors, typography, headline) in optimal platform aspect ratios (1:1, 4:5, 16:9, 9:16), optionally attaching directly in place to an existing campaign (contentId).

applyBrandTemplate.description: Overlay client brand colors, logo, typography, and optional headline onto the visual

contentId.description: Optional existing campaign contentId to attach the generated visual(s) directly in place without duplicating drafts

headline.description: Optional headline text rendered on the Brand Template overlay

platform.description: Optional target platform (e.g. "instagram", "linkedin", "x", "wordpress") for aspect ratio selection and campaign asset matching

prompt.description: AI image generation prompt or stock photo search topic

quantity.description: Number of visuals to generate (1 to 3, default 1)

templateId.description: Optional Brand Template ID (e.g. "std-photo-card", "std-editorial-card", "std-wave-split-card", or custom template UUID)

name: wordflux_generate_visual
